coallocation_definitions.p_uc: Mapped USDC participation of wallet u in category c divided by all mapped USDC participation of that wallet
coallocation_definitions.wallet_weighted_joint: O_cd=(1/N_active_wallets)*sum_u p_uc*p_ud; every active wallet receives equal weight
coallocation_definitions.amount_weighted_joint: O_cd=(1/sum_u s_u)*sum_u s_u*p_uc*p_ud, with s_u=total mapped maker+taker USDC participation
coallocation_definitions.interpretation: Descriptive joint category allocation for two independent within-wallet activity draws, then averaged over wallets using the stated weights; includes diagonals, is symmetric and sums to one
coallocation_definitions.not_inference: Not a null-model p-value, causal influence, inferred community partition, or taxonomy-independent network

limits: Complete mapped observed archive, not an independent proof of exhaustive on-chain coverage; wallet addresses are not unique persons; taxonomy is the frozen rule-based v3 classification; no node/edge projection or community inference is performed by this finalizer
